packet.headline_seed: If wings came before flight, what were they for?
packet.description_seed: Scientists use simulated dinosaurs to trigger real insect brains and test how wings originally evolved.

what: If wings came before flight, what were they for?

clean_source_blocks.text: Scientists use simulated dinosaurs to trigger real insect brains and test how wings originally evolved.

Flight may be one of evolution’s most iconic innovations, but zoologist Piotr Jablonski is convinced that early wings were first meant to be seen, not to fly. The idea came to Jablonski after studying bird behavior in the American West. He noticed some birds would fling out their wings or fan out their tail feathers to lure insects into the open. Then the birds would catch and eat the bugs. If early winged dinosaurs were the ancestors of birds, maybe the dinos did the same, he thought.
